findings.evidence: SmallX.lean:2-4 `Copyright (c) 2026 Joseph Tooby-Smith ... Authors: Joseph Tooby-Smith`; the diff removes that proof body from SmallX.lean and reproduces it verbatim in the new file, whose header reads `Authors: Wouter Deconinck`. Multi-author headers are already used in the repo (QFT/Scattering/DIS/PVES/Electroweak/Parameters.lean:4).
findings.fix: Make the Authors line `Authors: Joseph Tooby-Smith, Wouter Deconinck` (and keep the copyright consistent with SmallX.lean), and say in the module docstring that the lemma is the generalisation of the uniqueness step previously inlined in `Evolution/SmallX.lean`. This matters doubly because the file's path marks it PhyslibAlpha-eligible and would carry the wrong author upstream.
findings.issue: `ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc_of_lipschitzOnWith_closedBall` is the proof body of `bkSolution_unique_on_Icc` moved out of `EpsilonEridani/QFT/Factorization/Evolution/SmallX.lean` (same two `isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn` calls, same `max (max R₁ R₂) 0` radius, same closing `ODE_solution_unique_of_mem_Icc`, same docstring sentence), generalized over `v`; SmallX.lean's header credits Joseph Tooby-Smith, the new file credits only Wouter Deconinck.

findings.evidence: Diff adds `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/Analysis/ODE/ExistUnique/Extensions.lean` (51 lines); the description's file list omits it.
findings.fix: Add the third file to the description and state that its lemma is extracted and generalised from `bkSolution_unique_on_Icc` in `Evolution/SmallX.lean`.
findings.issue: The PR description states "Two new files are added" and lists only `Evolution/OneLoopCoupling.lean` and `Topology/Order/IntermediateValue/Extensions.lean`; the third new file `Mathematics/Analysis/ODE/ExistUnique/Extensions.lean` and the fact that it is extracted from existing SmallX.lean material are not disclosed anywhere.

summary: The one-loop file credits its informal sources properly, but the new ODE extension file is the proof of `bkSolution_unique_on_Icc` extracted from SmallX.lean (authored by Joseph Tooby-Smith) under a sole-author header crediting only Wouter Deconinck, with no note of origin in the file or the PR description.
